_meta.purpose: Single source of truth mapping every sealed-package artifact to its purpose, granularity, availability mode, and the Mode B sections that consume it. Rendered per-package into PACKAGE_MAP.json at seal time, and per-bundle into the execution-slice read-guidance. This file is the SSOT; nothing else hand-maintains the artifact->section relationship.
_meta.authoring_note: v0.3 by Claude (Round 8): validated every artifact name against a REAL modern gold package I ran this session. Six corrections from v0.2: (1) node_citation_map.json does NOT exist — the triage board carries Contig/Node_ID/antiSMASH_Region columns and is the real node-citation source; (2) locus maps are .svg not .png; (3) the domain_*.csv files are conditional (domain_level path) — the same per-domain data (2938 hits) lives in deep_data.json[domain_hits], now the §4/5/6 primary; (4) added gene_data.json (domain_arch/substrates/ripp/tfbs — the substrate source); (5) §15 missingness + §17 metabolomics live INSIDE manifest.json as top-level keys, not standalone files; (6) figure index real name is figures/figure_manifest.csv. 21 spec artifacts confirmed present with real names; the rest validated as conditional/external/tool with reasons. | v0.4: Citation_Ledger.json corrected to conditional (citation-compact only; confirmed absent on standard gold). §28 GAP was a spec error, now MODE_GATED; flagged the mandatory-section/conditional-evidence tension. | v0.5: added always_since_engine to every 'always' artifact so the read-gate can distinguish a LEGACY_ABSENT (package predates the artifact) from a real GAP (modern run failed to emit an artifact its engine version should produce). Values grounded in two real packages: 6 artifacts confirmed present in a v1.9.3-era reference package (always_since=1.9.3); the rest absent there but present in a v1.9.104 package (S. laurentii, public) (always_since=post-1.9.3, exact intro version undetermined — honest placeholder, not a fabricated number). | v0.6: scrubbed a real unpublished strain identifier from always_since_basis notes and the authoring note — replaced with generic version descriptors so the public spec is clean at source, not reliant on the tier redactor. S. laurentii references retained (public reference genome).

availability_modes.always: emitted on every run including --mode smoke

The spine of every card. CARRIES node/region citation columns directly (Contig, Node_ID, antiSMASH_Region, Composite_region) — this is the SOURCE for the node/contig-on-every-BGC standing rule, NOT a separate node_citation_map.json (which this engine version does not emit). v9.7.350 adds three UNCONDITIONAL region-structure columns - Protocluster_count (the true antiSMASH protocluster-feature count), Single_protocluster_count, and Chemical_hybrid - because Composite_region only fires at >=3 single-kind cand_clusters, so a TWO-protocluster merge was indistinguishable from a clean single-protocluster region. Structural capacity descriptors only; a chemical_hybrid region is a genuinely FUSED pathway and its merged product string must NOT be de-inflated.
